headline: Introduces small mode for BetterBags Next with movable panels, animated resizing, and chaining by dragging.

entries.title: Small mode for BetterBags Next
entries.details: Bags can now be toggled into a compact, movable mode suited for smaller screens using a button on the backpack header. Panels remember their positions, smoothly animate when resizing, and can be chained together by dragging them side by side.
